The '''Denova system''' was a system in the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had a presence on Denova due to the fact the planet contained [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], an ore. Thus, the Galactic Republic hired a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] army known as the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] to protect the mines from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the Warstalkers eventually went rogue and aligned themselves with the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]].<ref name="TORC" /> This betrayal was eventually solved by an elite ops team, and the planet, along with the mines, returned to Republic ownership. Denova and the rest of its system was then given military security to ensure this wouldn't happen again.

Years later, the planet and its system would eventually leave the Republic for the [[Eternal Alliance]] when the planets personnel did the same.
